text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>,

Thank you for your hard work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.6°C (normal), no body pain.
Meals: Attached records for 3 meals + 2 snacks."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Voluntary Training Report:
40 min outer track run (Morning),
5 km swim (Evening)"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is all. Please review it.

—Air Messiah"

In the trainer's office.
I read through the daily report from my trainee,
Air Messiah, which arrived right on time as usual.
choice_data_list: Yeah... alright, looks like there are no issues.
Yeah... alright, seems like there's no problem.

text_block_list.text:
"Air Messiah,

Thank you for the daily report. Acknowledged."
choice_data_list: "Looking forward to continuing our work together," and...

text_block_list.text: Even though it was a message exchange they had almost every day, they still gave it one last look over before clicking the send button.

After confirming the message was safely sent,
I took a breather. ...Receiving her daily report had become
my way of realizing another day had come to an end.

Normally, I would be heading home around now, but...
There is still one crucial task left to do today.
choice_data_list: I have to make the race schedule...!
We've got to make the race schedule...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! Then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So it's been decided, then. Your debut race.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's 1600m on the Kyoto turf.
Yeah. It's Kyoto Turf 1600m.

text_block_list.text:
I nod and urge her to check the newly created
"Race Schedule_1" file in the shared cloud folder.

We decided to create this shared cloud folder right after signing
with Air Messiah so we could easily discuss our future strategy.

By the way, inside the folder is a "Skill Chart" file
detailing Air Messiah's current physical abilities and such, as well as—
Various files such as "Training Schedule" and "Rival Data Analysis" are stored here.

I decided to append a number like "_1" to the end
of the file name, incrementing the count with each
update made.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: They often say the relationship between a Trainer and an Umamusume is a three-legged race, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I believe proper information sharing is essential
to making sure we proceed smoothly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "It will require quite a bit of effort on your part as well, Trainer, but..."
choice_data_list: No, this format works better for me too.
No, this format is easier for me too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm very glad to hear that.

It was also around this time that we decided to exchange daily reports.
My colleagues still ask me, "Isn't that a bit too formal?"
from time to time, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Step by step. Carefully and steadily.
Let us build upon our efforts.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: All so that we can seize victory that lies ahead.
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
And now, it's finally time for the Make Debut.
From here on out, our training will get even more intense, but...
choice_data_list: Before that... first comes this weekend, right?
Before that... first comes this weekend, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes, that's right.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to be on my best behavior...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
U-Um. Please, don't be so stiff.
They are also—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"My mother also mentioned,
'Please feel free to drop by anytime.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Ah!
—Mother! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Messiah! Hehe, welcome back.
And also—
choice_data_list: N-Nice to meet you! I'm <username>.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh... hello there, it is nice to meet you.
I am Air Messiah's mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making the trip out here today, Trainer.
There's no sense in standing around chatting... Shall we get going right away?
Afterward, I was invited to Air Messiah's home and exchanged formal greetings. Despite almost dropping my business card holder, I bowed with all my heart.
choice_data_list: Ah, and here's this as well— I hope it's to your liking!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother, here.
This is from my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you so much for your thoughtfulness.
Fufufu... My daughter told me about you, but you truly are so polite.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Please, have a seat.
Would coffee be alright with you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll go brew some.
Mother, please continue talking with the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Thank you, Messiah.
I've set out some tea sweets, so could you bring those over as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood.
Please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. If you don't mind,
I would love to ask you a few things.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: "First... yes. I've heard about it from her, but... would you mind telling me, in your own words, about when you formed your contract?"
choice_data_list: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Yes. You have a deep respect for my daughter's attitude and hard work, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I suppose I feel the same way. Even as a parent,
seeing her always so earnest and working steadily hard
makes me feel truly humbled.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. Everything I have
is a strength bestowed upon me by my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Steadily, surely.
Continuing to make an effort with an unwavering will."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It was none other than Mother
who showed me that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I suppose so. You always
say that, but—

While speaking, Air Messiah's mother glanced
at the corkboard on the wall.
Following her gaze, I looked over as well.

On that board, alongside several family photos...
was a single sheet of drawing paper.

On the drawing paper was a picture of an Umamusume,
seemingly drawn with all a child's might,
with the title "Passionate Newspaper" and—

"‘So, so amazing!’
‘She works hard, she's fast, and she's so cool!’
‘She's pretty, she's wonderful, and I love her so much!’"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
M-Mother!
When did you get this...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry. Ever since you left home,
it's felt so lonely around here...
So I dragged these out to where I could look at them.
choice_data_list: Is this... a handwritten newspaper article?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...!
Um, I'd really appreciate it if we didn't dig too deep into that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Messiah wrote that for me. Even though she was still so little, she lined up all those newspapers and tried her best to copy them."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to see my race for the first time...
Oh right, was it after I showed her
some articles from back then?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, well...

Air Messiah looked thoroughly embarrassed, but...
I couldn't help taking another good, long look at her.

It felt as though the very root of the deep respect and love for her mother
that she always speaks of was vividly depicted there,
even through clumsy drawings and handwriting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, w-will that be enough,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There are other places
I'd like to show you around today, after all...!
choice_data_list: Huh, anything else?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, that's right.
Now then... thank you very much for telling me all about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
Please take good care of my daughter.
And so, after exchanging polite farewells, I left Air Messiah's home.

Next, she guided me to...
a racing school located right near her house.
choice_data_list: Could this place be...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... My mother works as an instructor at this Umamusume training club.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This is where Umamusume who have set their sights on the world of racing
learn "how to run in the first place"... right here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Just as many former Tiara Umamusume who pursued the path of coaching had done before her――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"My mother also kept her trainees few in number
and prioritized one-on-one coaching.
Not just how to move the body, of course..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As if passing that will, that very soul, into the hands of each and every person.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Me too. It was carefully shaped
just like that by my mother's hands.
choice_data_list: The time you spent here with your mother is your true starting point.
The time spent here with your mother is your true origin.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
M-Mother, how was that...δη?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You've executed what I taught you before
wonderfully. Your form has become
quite beautiful, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: Really!? ...Is that true, Mother?!

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Did I... did I run well?
Just like Mother! Beautifully...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"This is my beginning.
My aspiration. My dream. And—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The beginning of an oath that must be fulfilled at all costs.

In that instant—the aura radiating from Air Messiah
sharpened with an electric crackle.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You saw that article, didn't you?
My... handwritten article.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I remember it well. The day I wrote that.
Gripping the crayon tightly... I misjudged my strength
and crushed a few of them into powder.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wrote it all out with the letters I had just learned.
With respect, with love, and then――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Channeling my anger.

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, no! This is all wrong!
Something is definitely, absolutely wrong!)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Because!! All the newspapers we saved,
every single one of them, all over the place!)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Calling Mother 'almost there'!)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Mother is so amazing!
She's so cool! And so beautiful!)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's why... *gh*... I'm the one who has to draw it...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From here—
Let us begin, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming the Make Debut and the Junior Class.
And now, into the pivotal second year... the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho...
I will surely seize victory along the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially the Shuka Sho.
That race where Mother was the G1 favorite for the first time
in her career... and suffered defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As their daughter, I will win.
And I will prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To prove that Mother was never just 'close'!
To show the sacred strength of the bloodline passed down to me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With these legs of mine—without fail!
choice_data_list: Yeah. We'll definitely see this through together.

text_block_list.text:
With the vow held in my heart, I face Air Messiah.
The succession is fulfilled upon this ground,
and destiny has already begun to run.

Our challenge in the Twinkle Series alongside her
is finally about to begin...!
